about.title: About
about.heroTitle: Sheeting and terry that wait for a signed set.
about.heroDescription: Hotel bedding and bath. Send a room list. We confirm mattress height and GSM, then put a set on a bed.
about.workflowDescription: Finish and volume pick the line. The signed set picks the packing week.
about.closingDescription: Send the room list or a mattress photo. Sample date and set MOQ in 48 hours.

contact.title: Contact
contact.heroTitle: Write to the merchandiser on the SKU.
contact.heroDescription: Sample set, logo proof or a hotel PO — one person dates it.

collections.title: Products
collections.heroDescription: Bedding, terry, curtains, table linen, embroidered pieces.
collections.benefitsDescription: Workshop, sample date, set MOQ, GSM or thread count, fitted-sheet drop.

hotels.title: For hospitality
hotels.description: GSM after the laundry, not before.
hotels.content: Towels that feel thick on the quote often go limp after industrial wash. We lock GSM and loop density on a washed sample and keep the SKU for call-off.

retailers.title: For retailers
retailers.description: Next lot matches the signed white.
retailers.content: Replenishment often shifts shade. The lot card stays with the signed set so the next dye is matched before packing.

developers.title: For property developers
developers.content: Fitted sheets fail when drop is guessed. Mattress thickness and drop are on the room list before we cut. Sheeting, curtains and bath SKUs are specified together.

sampling.title: Sampling
sampling.description: A set on a bed. A logo on terry.
sampling.content: Send a room list or artwork. Sample set is typically 12 days. Embroidery proof is stitched on the real towel before bulk heads run.

moq.title: MOQ & lead time
moq.description: Quoted per SKU, after the sample.
moq.content: A sample set can be a few units. Bulk MOQ is by property or colorway and is dated on the quote after you sign the set.

certifications.title: Certifications
certifications.description: OEKO-TEX on the lot you ship.
certifications.content: When you ask for a certified lot, the scope file travels with those cartons. Uncertified pieces stay off certified packing.

quality-control.title: Quality control
quality-control.content: Final audit: stitch, finish, embroidery against the proof, set completeness, carton count.

how-it-works.title: How it works
how-it-works.description: Room list in, signed set, then bulk.
how-it-works.content: Send the list → lock drop and GSM → sample the set → sign logo → make → count. Same merchandiser.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.content: Sample set about 12 days. Fitted-sheet drop and mattress height are required before cutting. OEKO-TEX is quoted per lot.
